concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-004 (total pipeline runtime ≤ 6 h) has no associated task. No task records or validates overall execution time, leaving this SC untestable.

Success Criterion SC-001 (interpolation R²) is not explicitly linked to a task that outputs the CV‑R² metric to a tracked artifact; T012 performs training but does not define a task to persist the interpolation R² score.
